name: Despoiled Spell (Metamagic)
body:
You can fuel a spell with your own life energy.

Benefit: A despoiled spell deals 2 points of Constitution damage to the caster when it is cast. This ability score cannot be healed or recovered until the caster regains use of that spell slot for the day. A despoiled spell uses up a spell slot one level lower than the spell’s actual level.
